Peter Brazaitis

Peter Brazaitis is a renowned researcher in the field of wildlife conservation. Career

Brazaitis has had a distinguished career in wildlife conservation, with a significant portion of his work being associated with the Wildlife Conservation Society (WCS). According to his biography on the WCS website, Brazaitis worked for the organization, where he contributed to various conservation efforts. [1]

During his tenure at WCS, Brazaitis was involved in several projects focused on protecting and preserving wildlife habitats, as well as researching and developing effective conservation strategies. His work with WCS has had a lasting impact on the field of wildlife conservation, and his expertise has been sought after by organizations and governments around the world. References
